name: Taj Mahal
descriptor: Ivory-white marble mausoleum on the Yamuna riverbank.

identifyingCues.text: large central onion dome on a drum
four slender minarets at plinth corners
white marble plinth with symmetrical iwan arches
long rectangular reflecting pool on the central axis

identity.text: Mausoleum commissioned by Mughal emperor Shah Jahan in memory of his wife Mumtaz Mahal.
Located on the south bank of the Yamuna River in Agra, Uttar Pradesh.

visiting.text: Open daily except Friday, sunrise to sunset. Entry via the west, east, or south gate.

conditions.text: Flat riverbank terrain. The site can experience extreme heat in May–June (above 45 °C) and monsoon flooding of the Yamuna in July–September.

context.text: A UNESCO World Heritage Site since 1983, regarded as the finest example of Mughal architecture combining Persian, Islamic, and Indian styles.
